pos.personaBrief: Sampaoli's Chile built from deep with Juego de Posicion ('Posesion 74'), pivot Diaz and Vidal-Aranguiz-Valdivia circulating; wanted control against powers; Pizzi spoke of dominating play.

pro.personaBrief: Goalkeeper Bravo and centre-backs always played out short, even under pressure; the pivot dropped to create a 3v2; the attack is fast after regains but built through short transitions.

est.personaBrief: Fluid shape (back three/four shifting, Diaz between centre-backs, Valdivia as false 9 connecting lines) and combinations of Vidal-Aranguiz-Valdivia; the scheme is 'anecdotal', the form matters; Sanchez drifts from the wings.

lar.personaBrief: Chile widened the pitch all game and exploited the flanks 'a morir'; wingbacks hugging the touchline, Sanchez and Fuenzalida wide under Pizzi, ball spread wide against Argentina.

blo.personaBrief: Most defending in the opponent's half, high line, aggressive press and counterpress with Sanchez pressing the ball; Pizzi also asked for intensity and aggression.

mar.personaBrief: The back line man-marked dropping players, and Pizzi built the final plan around isolating Messi; no corner source, so a mild lean toward individual duties.

pla.personaBrief: Sampaoli imposed his Bielsa-derived model but tweaked shape by opponent (4-1-2-1-2 vs weaker, 3-4-1-2 vs better) and Pizzi adapted to cut Messi's supply; the core press and possession identity stayed.

res.personaBrief: Aggressive, protagonist football, believed they could take on anyone; Sampaoli rejected the cautious shift as risky; goal was winning the title, but with an attacking style.

sis.personaBrief: Collective pressing system demanded of everyone, including Sanchez and Vidal; but the stars (Sanchez, Vidal, Valdivia) had freedom within a drilled model; Pizzi gave Vidal the freedom he needed.

jog.personaBrief: Technical midfield (Diaz, Aranguiz, Valdivia) paired with high-energy pressing; short defence compensated physically by anticipation and speed; a creative Valdivia was valued.

bas.personaBrief: National team built on a golden generation of veterans (Bravo, Vidal, Medel, Sanchez); Pizzi was warned about blooding youngsters but picked in-form lower-profile players, not academy products.

lid.personaBrief: Sampaoli built a close group and protected its intimacy; Pizzi dropped Vidal's and Medel's friend and defended Bravo; stars were treated as part of the group but the coach decided.
